Calculates the total contributing areas as the real, three-dimensional surface of the cells draining into each cell, instead of their number: on steep terrain the surface of a cell is larger than its plan area.

**Toolbox folder:** Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Geomorphology, Contributing area, 3D<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Tca3d`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inPit` | raster file | m |  | The map of the depitted elevation. |
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outTca` | output file | m² | The map of the three-dimensional total contributing areas. |
